faction_rules.name: Astartes
faction_rules.description: During each friendly ANGEL OF DEATH operative's activation, it can perform either two Shoot actions or two Fight actions.

faction_rules.name: Chapter Tactics
faction_rules.description: Select two Chapter Tactics at the start of the battle (e.g. Aggressive, Dueller, Resolute, Sharpshooter, Siege Specialist, Stealthy).

abilities.name: Iron Halo
abilities.description: Once per battle, ignore the damage inflicted from one attack die.

abilities.name: Heroic Leader
abilities.description: Use a Firefight Ploy for 0CP once per Turning Point.

abilities.name: Doctrine Mastery
abilities.description: Gain Balanced on Bolt weapons or melee weapons.

abilities.name: Camo Cloak
abilities.description: Retain an additional cover save while in cover.

abilities.name: Grenadier
abilities.description: Equipped with free Frag and Krak grenades with +1 Hit.

ploys.name: Combat Doctrine
ploys.description: Friendly ANGEL OF DEATH operatives gain Balanced on ranged attacks within 8" or at long range.

ploys.name: And They Shall Know No Fear
ploys.description: Ignore APL modifiers and injured Hit penalties for friendly operatives.

ploys.name: Wrath of Vengeance
ploys.description: After an operative incapacitates an enemy, perform an additional Shoot or Fight action.

ploys.name: Transhuman Physiology
ploys.description: Retain one normal defense success as a critical success instead.

equipment.name: Purity Seals
equipment.description: Once per Turning Point, if a friendly operative rolls two or more fails in a Shoot or Fight action, discard one fail to retain another fail as a normal success.

equipment.name: Chapter Reliquaries
equipment.description: Allows re-rolling one defense die per Turning Point.

equipment.name: Tilting Shields
equipment.description: Opponent cannot retain critical hits on better than 6+ in melee against friendly operatives.

equipment.name: Auspex
equipment.description: Once per Turning Point, ignore Obscured for a friendly operative's Shoot action.

faction_rules.name: Disgustingly Resilient
faction_rules.description: Whenever an attack die would inflict 3 or more damage on a friendly PLAGUE MARINE operative, roll 1D6: on 4+, subtract 1 from the damage inflicted.

faction_rules.name: Poison
faction_rules.description: Enemy operatives within Contagion range or damaged by Poison weapons gain a Poison token (1D3 damage on activation and -1 Hit vs Plague Marines).

abilities.name: Grandfather's Blessing
abilities.description: Regain D3 lost wounds at the start of activation.

abilities.name: Gift of Contagion
abilities.description: Psychic action to reduce enemy APL or worsen save.

abilities.name: Icon of Contagion
abilities.description: +1 APL when determining control of objective markers.

ploys.name: Contagion
ploys.description: Enemy operatives within 3" of friendly PLAGUE MARINE operatives suffer -1 Hit.

ploys.name: Cloud of Flies
ploys.description: Friendly operatives within 3" of a Smoke or Contagion marker are Obscured from >6".

equipment.name: Plague Bells
equipment.description: Once per Turning Point, add 1" to the Movement stat of a friendly PLAGUE MARINE operative.

equipment.name: Blight Grenades
equipment.description: Frag grenades equipped by friendly operatives gain the Poison and Severe rules.

faction_rules.name: Throat Slittas
faction_rules.description: Friendly KOMMANDO operatives can perform a Charge action while they have a Conceal order.

abilities.name: Get It Dun!
abilities.description: Add 1 to the APL of a friendly KOMMANDO operative within 6".

abilities.name: Breach
abilities.description: Move through wall terrain up to 1" thick as open ground.

ploys.name: Sssshhhh!
ploys.description: Friendly KOMMANDO operatives with a Conceal order out of 6" can perform a free Dash.

ploys.name: Just a Scratch
ploys.description: Ignore the damage inflicted from one normal attack die.

equipment.name: Dynamite
equipment.description: Grants the Dynamite ranged weapon (ATK 4, HIT 4+, DMG 5/6, Range 4", Blast 1", Heavy, Piercing 1, Limited 1).

faction_rules.name: Skill at Arms
faction_rules.description: At the start of each Turning Point, select one Skill at Arms (e.g. Light 'Em Up for Severe on ranged weapons, Strike Fast for +1" Move, Ice in Your Veins).

abilities.name: Tactical Command
abilities.description: Use an additional Skill at Arms on a friendly operative.

equipment.name: Foregrip
equipment.description: Hot-shot weapons gain Accurate 1 when shooting targets within 6".

faction_rules.name: Guardsman Orders
faction_rules.description: Issue Guardsman Orders (Take Aim!, Fix Bayonets!, Move! Move! Move!, Dig In!) across the killzone.

abilities.name: Guardsman Orders
abilities.description: Issue a Guardsman Order for 1 AP.

ploys.name: In Death, Atonement
ploys.description: When incapacitated, the operative can perform one 1AP action before being removed.

faction_rules.name: Marks of Chaos
faction_rules.description: Assign Khorne, Nurgle, Tzeentch, Slaanesh, or Undivided Marks to operatives for tailored combat blessings.

abilities.name: Soul Gorge
abilities.description: Regain 2 lost wounds whenever this operative incapacitates an enemy in melee.

abilities.name: Unleash Daemon
abilities.description: Can fight twice per activation while Daemon is unleashed.

faction_rules.name: Drop Insertion
faction_rules.description: Deploy Drop Markers and grav-chute insert operatives during Turning Points 1 and 2.

faction_rules.name: Airborne Predators
faction_rules.description: Fly across terrain during Reposition and Charge actions.

faction_rules.name: Communion
faction_rules.description: Spend Communion points to direct Stingwing targets and gain Neutron rules.

faction_rules.name: In Midnight Clad
faction_rules.description: Operatives in cover and >6" from enemies are Obscured.

abilities.name: Premonition
abilities.description: Force an enemy roll to be re-rolled once per Turning Point.

faction_rules.name: Aspect Techniques
faction_rules.description: Execute Dire Avenger, Howling Banshee, and Striking Scorpion Aspect Techniques.

faction_rules.name: Markerlights
faction_rules.description: Place Markerlight tokens on enemy operatives to grant Accurate, Saturate, and +1 Hit.

faction_rules.name: Reanimation Protocols
faction_rules.description: Place Reanimation markers when operatives are incapacitated and attempt reanimation on 3+.

faction_rules.name: Grudge
faction_rules.description: Assign Grudge tokens to enemy operatives; retain one normal hit as a critical hit per Grudge token.

faction_rules.name: Boon of Tzeentch
faction_rules.description: Select Boons of Tzeentch for Sorcerer operatives.

faction_rules.name: Omni-Scramblers
faction_rules.description: Delay enemy operative activations each Turning Point.

faction_rules.name: Aeldari Raiders
faction_rules.description: Operatives can perform a free Dash action during their activation.

universal_equipment.name: Explosive Grenades (2x Frag or 2x Krak or 1x each)
universal_equipment.description: Select two Explosive Grenades (Frag: ATK 4, HIT 4+, DMG 2/4, Range 6", Blast 2", Saturate; Krak: ATK 4, HIT 4+, DMG 4/5, Range 6", Piercing 1, Saturate).

universal_equipment.name: Utility Grenades (2x Smoke or 2x Stun or 1x each)
universal_equipment.description: Select two Utility Grenades (Smoke Grenade creates a 1" obscuring smoke zone; Stun Grenade tests operatives within 2" for -1 APL).

universal_equipment.name: Light Barricades (2x)
universal_equipment.description: Set up two Light Barricade terrain features wholly within your territory.

universal_equipment.name: Heavy Barricade (1x)
universal_equipment.description: Set up one Heavy Barricade terrain feature wholly within your territory.

universal_equipment.name: Ladders (2x)
universal_equipment.description: Set up two Ladders to reduce vertical climb cost to 1".

universal_equipment.name: Razor Wire (1x)
universal_equipment.description: Set up one Razor Wire obstacle that penalizes movement across it by 2".

universal_equipment.name: Ammo Cache (1x)
universal_equipment.description: Friendly operatives within 1" can spend 1 AP to gain Balanced on a ranged weapon for the Turning Point.

universal_equipment.name: Comms Device (1x)
universal_equipment.description: Increases the range of friendly support/aura actions by 3" while within 1" of the device.
